articles.headline: Louisville's Kelsey tells 5th-year critics 'bring it' as Trimble shines in upset

article.headline: Worrell, Morgan State knock off Loyola (Md.) 63-61 in OT
article.description: — Alfred Worrell Jr. scored 22 points, including a game-winning jumper just before the overtime buzzer as Morgan State defeated Loyola (Md.) 63-61 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Worrell, Morgan State knock off Loyola (Md.) 63-61 in OT

categories.description: Morgan State Bears @ Loyola Maryland Greyhounds

event.description: Morgan State Bears @ Loyola Maryland Greyhounds

keywords: Morgan State Bears @ Loyola Maryland Greyhounds
article.story: TOWSON, Md. -- — Alfred Worrell Jr. scored 22 points, including a game-winning jumper just before the overtime buzzer as Morgan State defeated Loyola (Md.) 63-61 on Saturday. Worrell shot 8 for 15 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Bears (4-1). Jeremiah Kwarteng scored 13 points while shooting 3 for 14 (0 for 4 from 3-point range) and 7 of 14 from the free-throw line, and added six rebounds. Ibi Traore had 12 points and finished 6 of 9 from the floor. D’Andre Harrison paced the Greyhounds (1-4) with 18 points, 18 rebounds and two steals. Leo Ricketts added 14 points. Up next Morgan State plays Wednesday against North Carolina A&T on the road. Loyola (Md.) visits Virginia on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
